description: Checked facts for one London sight: opening hours for each day (with the date they were checked), last entry, seasonal closures, ticket price, how long a visit takes, the nearest station and its step-free access, accessibility and address. Use when someone asks "is the Tower of London open on Monday?", "how much is St Paul's?" or "nearest Tube to the Shard".

date.description: Optional date of the visit (YYYY-MM-DD), to say whether it is open that day.

name.description: The place's name or a common nickname (e.g. "V&A", "Kew Gardens").

name: london_place_info
title: London place facts
